analysis.title: ConocoPhillips (COP): First Take: Solid EPS Beat, 11% Dividend Raise and Preliminary Thoughts on 2027 Plan Provided; Buy
key_insights: COP reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $3.27 vs GS estimate $3.08 and FactSet consensus $3.05. Reported EPS was $3.34 including $83 mn of special items.
The beat came from stronger U.S. earnings than the GS model. U.S. E&P earnings were $2,917 mn vs GS $2,765 mn, international $1,077 mn vs GS $1,151 mn, and corporate was -$76 mn vs GS -$225 mn.
Total production was ~2,302 MBOE/d, in line with GS at ~2,305 and FactSet consensus at ~2,298. Lower 48 averaged ~1,517 MBOE/d: Delaware ~757, Midland ~197, Eagle Ford ~369, Bakken ~191.
Adjusted cash flow from operations excluding working capital was ~$7.2 bn vs GS estimate of ~$6.9 bn.
Shareholder distributions rose to ~$3.4 bn in the quarter, including ~$2.4 bn of buybacks. COP is on track to return 45% of cash from operations this year.
Management raised the quarterly ordinary dividend by 11% to $0.93/sh.

Management expects low single-digit underlying production growth next year with steady-state Lower 48 activity, and lower capital spend next year, contributing to a multi-year free cash flow inflection.
Willow module fabrication scope is over 75% complete, with first oil targeted for early 2029.

GS lists call topics: Willow operations, Lower 48 activity, LNG projects (Qatar NFE and NFS startup timing amid Middle East supply constraints), capital spend, shareholder returns and free cash flow growth.
GS reiterates Buy with a 12-month price target of $157 vs the $136.94 close on 4 Nov 2026 (14.6% upside). Key risks are commodity prices, capital spend and operational execution.

market_movers.rationale: Buy and $157 target (unchanged from the 20-Oct-26 target in the history table) after a 3Q26 adjusted EPS beat, an 11% dividend raise and 45% of cash from operations returned year to date. The target rests on 12-month EV/DACF, P/E and DCF.

earnings_insights: COP 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported $3.27 (reported basis $3.34) vs GS estimate $3.08 and FactSet consensus $3.05. The quarter has already been reported (5 Nov 2026).
3Q26 net adjusted income to common reported $3,918 mn vs GS estimate $3,691 mn. Special items were $83 mn.
3Q26 adjusted cash flow from operations reported ~$7,172 mn vs GS estimate $6,948 mn.
3Q26 total production reported ~2,302 MBOE/d vs GS estimate ~2,305 and FactSet consensus ~2,298. Liquids were 1,643 Mb/d vs GS 1,678 and natural gas 3,960 MMcf/d vs GS 3,762.
4Q26 production guidance is ~2,320-2,360 MBOE/d. GS 4Q26 EPS estimate is $2.89 and 2026E EPS is $11.11 (GS estimates).
Shareholder distributions were ~$3.4 bn in 3Q26 (~$2.4 bn buybacks), with 45% of cash from operations to be returned in 2026.
risk_factors: Operational execution, including Willow gating items ahead of first oil in early 2029 and Qatar LNG startup timing.
geopolitical: GS asks on the call how Middle East supply constraints have altered the startup timelines for the Qatar LNG projects NFE and NFS.
